rule: lab/SCOPE.md 2.4 (Sam's corrected numeric rule): exact round trip; order-preserving range comparison; hard error, never silent conversion; integers >= 2^53

verdicts.ok: measured outcome agrees with the spec (exact where claimed exact, or caught by a rule)
verdicts.critical-silent-change: a value came back different with no error, where the spec claims exact (or on the ledger, always)
verdicts.spec-claims-exact-but-rejected: spec claims exact; the engine refused the value with an error (not silent, but a valid write fails)
verdicts.spec-conservative: spec marks inexact; the engine held the value exactly
verdicts.critical-spec-says-native-order-but-diff: spec says native ordering; engine order or range filter differs from Triplex order
verdicts.n/a-encoding-refused-by-spec: EXP-F02b: the XTDB wire encoding this path used is not the attribute's pinned encoding; ProjectionSpec.checkXtdbWire refuses it (typed ProjectionSpecError unpinned-encoding)
verdicts.critical-no-pinned-path-measured: EXP-F02b: no measured path used the spec's pinned encoding for this kind and cardinality, so the falsifier proved nothing for it
